entry: path-constraint MIX timeline block B17 0x28e8ec-0x28ea0c (73 insns) inside census span 0x28e8ec-0x28ea88
scope: Reconstructed B17 only: the "mix" skip guard, the immediate create + unconditional +0x14 index store, the time/rotateMix/translateMix frame loop with readCurve, and the three-float publish/duration tail. Real Json_getFloat, real readCurve, real _malloc/_free/_calloc and the real error chain are linked. Synthetic boundaries: spPathConstraintMixTimeline_create/setFrame (argument recorders whose store shape follows the disassembled bodies), spCurveTimeline_setStepped/setCurve recorders, fixture heap + allocator roster, libc providers, hand-built Json nodes. The census span also contains five foreign islands entered from outside B17; they are pinned as boundary evidence and NOT translated here. Not an original-equivalence claim.

puzzle.target_semantics: 0x28e048 ldr r4,[r4] = the shared timeline-node advance; 0x28e04c cmp / 0x28e050 bne 0x28df3c continues B13's inner dispatch loop
puzzle.conclusion: a path sub-key named exactly "mix" is handled by NOBODY: B17 skips it silently (no create, no setFrame, no readCurve, no publish, no duration update, no error). Every OTHER name falls through and IS loaded as a mix timeline (type 13). The compiled guard is `strcmp(name,"mix") == 0 -> goto next`; a missing `== 0` at source level is a hypothesis, not a bytecode claim.
puzzle.who_else_compares_mix: B13 compares only "position"/"spacing"; B6/B12/B14-B16 do not see path sub-keys. No other block claims the name.

boundary.census_span: 0x28e8ec-0x28ea88 (412 B / 103 insns) also contains 30 foreign instructions
foreign_islands: 0x28ea74-0x28ea7c (3) B13 spacing scale, from 0x28e550 (already in c/spine_read_tl_path)
boundary.b17_has_no_error_block: its BL roster is strcmp / create / Json_getFloat x3 / setFrame / readCurve only
boundary.b17_has_no_lookup_or_scan: no spSkeletonData_findPathConstraint call; it consumes B13's [sp+0x2c] cell at 0x28e914
boundary.key_decode_correction: pool 0x28eb14 + add 0x28e938 (PC base 0x28e940) = 0x357cc0 "rotateMix"; there is no +4 "teMix" suffix. The sibling path checker used 0x28e93c (a str) as the add site.
